Demographics.source: Certified (a)(5); visible in C-CDA header and portal screenshot
Demographics.notes: Standard C-CDA demographics header fields visible in screenshots

Problems / Conditions / Diagnoses.source: Certified (a)(2); problem list in EMR screenshot
Problems / Conditions / Diagnoses.notes: C-CDA Problems section visible with ICD codes in screenshot (page 3)

Medications / Prescriptions.notes: C-CDA Medications section present. However, detailed Rx history (refills, pharmacy info, prior auth) likely not in C-CDA

Immunizations.notes: Not visible in portal section list (page 8), but may be in C-CDA body. Immunization registry export exists as separate report.

Lab Results.source: Lab integration feature; Results icon on dashboard
Lab Results.notes: C-CDA Results section present. Labs Filed Report exists separately, suggesting structured lab data beyond C-CDA

Clinical Notes / Documents.source: Dragon dictation integration; templates; encounter notes
Clinical Notes / Documents.notes: C-CDA may include some note content, but rich dictated notes, custom templates, and attached documents are unlikely to be fully represented in C-CDA XML

Encounters / Visits.source: Core EMR function; Patient Census feature
Encounters / Visits.notes: C-CDA Encounters section present but likely contains summary data, not full encounter details

Care Plans / Goals.source: CCM and TCM features (dashboard icons visible)
Care Plans / Goals.notes: CCM List and TCM List are separate dashboard modules. No care plan section visible in C-CDA export

Insurance / Coverage.source: Real-time eligibility checking; Insurance Eligibility Status report
Insurance / Coverage.notes: Insurance data visible in patient search (e.g., 'Aetna HMO', 'Aetna PPO') but not part of C-CDA export

Claims / Billing.source: Core business - managed billing service; Billing icon on dashboard; multiple billing reports
Claims / Billing.notes: Billing/claims is the PRIMARY business of ClaimPower. Multiple billing reports visible (Billing Sent, Billing Stats, Daily Office Collection). None of this data is in C-CDA.

Payments.source: Patient Payments feature on website; credit card processing; ERA/EOB posting
Payments.notes: Payment data is a core part of the billing workflow. Not representable in C-CDA.

Patient Communications / Portal Messages.source: Secure messaging in portal (visible in screenshot); text messaging feature
Patient Communications / Portal Messages.notes: Portal has 'Secure Messaging' section (page 8 screenshot). Not part of C-CDA export.

Scanned / Attached Documents.source: Attach Documents icon on dashboard; document indexing at $0.10/page
Scanned / Attached Documents.notes: Document scanning/indexing is a paid feature. Scanned images/PDFs cannot be represented in C-CDA.

Orders / Referrals.notes: CPOE orders (lab, imaging, referral) are not standard C-CDA Summary of Care sections

Implantable Devices.notes: Certified for (a)(14) implantable device list, but no evidence it's in the C-CDA export sections
